# <span id="aanchor49"></span> User Access

FLOWCAL IDs are used to control access to forms and functionality and to maintain an audit trail for changes.

Run the User Privileges report to view the privileges for each user ID based on user and group permissions.

An administrator can grant individual processes and privileges to control the type of access users have (this requires **Application Process - User Security** privileges).

When a FLOWCAL ID is created, a corresponding Oracle user account is created. The Oracle account is tightly controlled using roles. FLOWCAL IDs are created and maintained through the User Access screen.

During user creation, the user type must be designated as "Standard" or "Instant". Designating a user as "Instant" will enable the Instant Login feature for the user. This designation cannot be changed after the user has been created.

Users who are part of security groups can be granted additional privileges at the user level to increase access that may not be required for the group. User privileges will override the group privilege settings. You must log out and log back in to refresh your privileges.

<div class="procedure">

To access the User Access screen: 

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select users in the security group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 527;height: 427;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="General Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />User Access Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="General Details">

The following items are available on the User Access screen:

- **Type** - Select **Instant** to enable the Instant Login feature for the user; otherwise, select **Standard**. This designation cannot be changed after the user is created.

- **ID** - The ID that is logged during edits and throughout the audit trail in FLOWCAL. This is the username entered when logging into FLOWCAL.

- **Name** - Informational field only; this data is not used elsewhere in the application. Some companies use a numeric ID, so the name is used to further identify the ID.

- **Contact** - Create a contact for a user in FLOWCAL and associate the contact information with the user by selecting the contact name from the drop-down list.

  An option to email logged in users in FLOWCAL uses the email address defined for the associated contact. The contact must exist in the system prior to selection. This is not required and can be updated at a future date.

- **System** - Privileges are configured for each ID for each system. An ID can have access to multiple systems. For example: An ID can have view-only access on one system and edit privileges on another system. Users will only be able to see the systems they have access to. Access to a system is provided by an administrator using the System Manager.

  The default system is "ENTERPRISE," but there could be additional systems to choose from such as "GAS" or "LIQUID". By selecting a system from the System drop-down box on the User or Group Access screens, security can be defined uniquely within each system for a user or group ID.

  This feature requires the Multi-System Extension module.

- **Groups** - Displays the security groups associated with the ID.

- **User May Access All Meters** - This option will allow a user to select any meter within the system. This option only grants the ability to select meters; what a user can do with the meter data is still restricted by the user's privileges.

<!-- -->

- **User May Access All Quality Sources** - This option will allow a user to select any quality source within the system. This option only grants the ability to select quality sources; what a user can do with the quality source data is still restricted by the user's privileges.

<!-- -->

- **User May Access All Locations** - This option will allow a user to select any location within the system. This option only grants the ability to select locations; what a user can do with the location data is still restricted by the user's privileges.

<!-- -->

- **Edit Approval Limits** - Determines the maximum amount of total edits for volume and energy that a user or group can approve for each meter, in a given month.

  - **Custom Limit** - User-defined limits for the maximum PPA or edit the user can approve.
  - **System Limit** - Limits defined within System Configuration screen or System Manager.
  - **No Limit** - No approval limit restrictions are set for the user.

  The ID must also have the Edit/PPA Approval - Can Approve privilege.

- **Password Expires\*** - When this option is checked, the Expiration Frequency option is enabled. If enabled, the user will be warned of impending expiration 10 days in advance. Once the password has expired, the user will be forced to change it before access to FLOWCAL will be allowed.

- **Expiration Frequency\*** - Specify the number of months to elapse before the ID expires and the user must change their password. This option is available when Password Expires is checked.

- **Password Expires On\*** - Automatically shows the ID expiration date based on the specified expiration frequency.

- **Edit Password\*** - When creating a new user or if an existing user forgets a password, the administrator can change the password for the user. The user will log in with the new password but will be immediately prompted to change the password.

  If the password is not edited, the default password for a new user is "NEWUSER".

  \*These options are not available for FLOWCAL Instant Login users.

- **User Creation Date** - Datetime the ID was created.

- **Last Logged on Date** - Datetime the ID last logged in to the current FLOWCAL database.

- **Application Process** - Security options affect all processes across the application for all systems.

- **System Process** - Security settings defined per system.

- **Ticket Access** - If this option is enabled, ticket access can be restricted by ticket status.

  The "Finalized" ticket status is only populated if the "Automatically Finalize" FLOWCAL configuration option is enabled. The "Automatically Finalize" option is only available with FLOWCAL 8.11.38 and earlier versions.

- **Check All** - Grant all privileges for all application processes or system processes.

- **Clear All** - Remove all privileges for all application processes or system processes.

- **Refresh** - Reload the ID from the database.

- **New** - Create a new ID.

- **Edit** - Edit an existing ID.

- **Enable / Disable** - Enable or disable an ID. IDs cannot be deleted in FLOWCAL to maintain the existing audit trail. However, the ID can be disabled to prohibit the user from logging in. To view disabled IDs, while in view mode, right-click the ID drop-down and select **Show Disabled Users**. A user in Oracle may be removed, if desired, after the corresponding ID has been disabled in FLOWCAL.

- **Save** - Save changes.

- **Cancel** - Cancel changes.

- **Exit** - Exit the screen.

- **Settings** - Each ID has a set of user preferences, such as a preferred location and default system. Click this button to access the [User Preferences](../User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md) screen.

- **Notes** - Add notes to a given ID.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Application Process Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Application Process Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Application Process Details">

The following items are available in the Application Process section of the User Access screen:

- **Close Groups** - Grant access to create, edit, and delete close groups.
- **Data Archive** - Grant access to view and edit data archive-related settings.
- **FLOWCAL Options** - Grant access to several groupings within the Settings Manager screen (Services, Application Geographic, and Liquids).
- **Personality** - Allow toggle between FLOWCAL and TESTit using the **Ctl+T** functionality. (Applicable to TESTit Integrated v2 only.)
- **System** - Grant access to create, edit, and delete systems from the System Manager.
- **TESTit Admin** - Grant access to the administrative features under the TESTit Manager menu (TESTit Options, Data Map Editor, and some administrative menus under TESTit Scheduler).
- **Ticket Autofill** - Grant access to set up default values for ticket fields.
- **User Security** - Grant access to User/Group Access within FLOWCAL.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="System Process Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />System Process Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="System Process Details">

The following items are available in the System Process section of the User Access screen:

- **Data Transfer** - Import and export privileges control access to the Data Transfer module within FcDataBoss.
- **Meter Edit - Can Delete** - This privilege is commonly withheld from users that are limited to day-to-day processing.
- **Purge - Historical Purge** - Historical purge privilege controls access to the Historical Purge module in FcDataBoss.

</div>
